limits: Coarse terrain cannot resolve paved terraces, narrow retaining walls, building feet or underground parking. Pixel ground spacing is a sample interval, not surveyed resolution. Native vertical datum/vintage/under-building contamination remain unverified.

Palace/forecourt level is the highest occupied platform sample plus 0.25 m; one rigid palace shift preserves its relative architectural heights. Garden/riding hall keep that explicitly interpreted level; four historical garden terraces remain unmeasured. Other barracks and gates use separate highest footprint/entry samples plus 0.15/0.12 m with bounded civil connections.

Mapped structural skirts extend four meters below retained ground. Broad park/hill is exclusively host terrain. No whole-precinct cut or replacement. Crown Tower 47 m published height versus OSM 31 m part height has unresolved datum scope; interpreted roof-tip height is retained, not called surveyed.

inspection.notes: Actually inspected all 25 final normal-placement terrain images: original derivative and four browser levels each show the whole castle plus Vienna, Sigismund, Nicholas and Leopold passages. Gates remain open, approach decks fit this retained terrain, sampled palace retaining faces meet grade, and the park remains host ground. Garden is an interpreted flat upper platform; its large eastern retaining face reflects unresolved coarse terrain/terrace levels. This is accepted medium-fi exterior scope, not a survey or fit to arbitrary host terrain.
